Faculty Guide          


1. Project Overview

Title: Campus Recruitment System (CRS)
Platform: Android
Technology Stack: Firebase, Java, Android SDK
Purpose: A comprehensive recruitment platform connecting students, companies, and administrators for seamless job applications, interviews, and feedback.

2. Key Modules & Features

Student Module:
Search Jobs: Browse available job postings with search functionality.
Apply for Jobs: Submit applications with student details, resume, and CGPA validation.
Track Applications: View application status (Pending/Approved/Rejected).
Track Interviews: View scheduled interviews with details.
Provide Feedback: Submit feedback about the recruitment process.






Company Module:
Post Jobs: Create job listings with required skills, CGPA, and job type.
Review Applications: View and approve/reject student applications.
Schedule Interviews: Schedule interviews for approved candidates.
Manage Previous Interviews: View past interviews.
Submit Feedback: Provide feedback on the recruitment system.

Admin Module:
Manage Users: View/delete students and companies.
Manage Applications: View/delete all submitted applications.
Manage Jobs: View/delete all posted jobs.
Manage Interviews: View/delete all scheduled interviews.
Manage Feedback: View/delete feedback from students and companies.

3. Technology Stack
Frontend: Android Studio, Java, XML
Backend: Firebase Realtime Database, Firebase Authentication
Architecture: MVC-based with structured packages
Tools: Gradle, Firebase Console, Android SDK

4. Database Structure
Users: Students and Companies (under users/students and users/companies)
Jobs: Posted jobs (globalJobs and company-specific jobs)
Applications: Student applications (globalApplications and company-specific applications)
Interviews: Scheduled interviews (globalInterviews and company-specific interviews)Feedback: Student and company feedback (feedback/students, feedback/companies)

5. Key Features Highlight
Role-Based Access: Separate dashboards for Student, Company, and Admin.
Dynamic Data Loading: Jobs, companies, and applications loaded dynamically from Firebase.
CGPA Validation: Prevents students from applying if CGPA requirement is not met.
Real-Time Updates: Applications, interviews, and feedback updated in real-time.
Secure Authentication: Firebase Authentication with role-based login.

6. Application Flow
Registration/Login: Users register with role-based details.
Dashboard Navigation: Each role accesses specific features.
Student Flow: Search Job → Apply → Track Application → Track Interview → Give Feedback.
Company Flow: Post Job → Review Applications → Schedule Interviews → Give Feedback.
Admin Flow: Manage all entities (students, companies, jobs, applications, interviews, feedback).

7. Screens & Activities
LoginActivity: Role-based authentication.
StudentDashboardActivity: Central hub for student actions.
CompanyDashboardActivity: Central hub for company actions.
AdminDashboardActivity: Central hub for admin actions.
SearchJobActivity, ApplyJobActivity, TrackApplicationsActivity, etc.: Feature-specific screens.



8. Adapters & Models
Adapters: StudentAdapter, CompanyAdapter, JobAdapter, ApplicationAdapter, InterviewAdapter, FeedbackAdapter
Models: Student, Company, Job, Application, Interview, Feedback, User

9. Security & Validation
Firebase Authentication: Secure login and user management.
Input Validation: CGPA, email, and required field validation.
Permission Handling: Access control based on user role.

10. Advantages
Centralized Platform: Streamlines recruitment process for all stakeholders.
offline Capability: Firebase provides real-time sync and offline support.
Scalable: Modular design allows easy addition of new features.
User-Friendly: Intuitive UI with clear navigation.

11. Limitations
Platform Dependency: Android-only.
Internet Required: Real-time features depend on internet connectivity.
Firebase Costs: Large-scale usage may incur Firebase costs.

12. Future Enhancements
Push Notifications: Notify students about interview schedules and application status.
Resume Upload: Direct file upload instead of link.
Analytics Dashboard: Admin insights into application trends.
Chat System: Direct communication between students and companies.

13. Conclusion
The Campus Recruitment System provides a robust, scalable, and efficient platform for managing campus recruitment processes. It simplifies job applications, interview scheduling, and feedback collection, benefiting students, companies, and administrators alike. Built with modern Android development practices and Firebase, it ensures reliability, security, and a seamless user experience.
